rows.assumption: pcie_fabric is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Host control must enumerate and command the accelerator over a declared PCIe fabric.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review the interface carrier, direction, capacity, safety margin and failure mode before detailed design or sourcing.

rows.assumption: gpu_power_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Accelerator power must be isolated from lower-power appliance rails.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review the interface carrier, direction, capacity, safety margin and failure mode before detailed design or sourcing.

rows.assumption: inference_network is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: storage_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: thermal_path is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Accelerator and CPU heat must couple into the cooling path.

rows.assumption: sensor_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: hardwired_trip is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Thermal and electrical safety faults must force power shutdown.

rows.assumption: airflow_path is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: The rack chassis must preserve the front-to-back airflow path used by cooling.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review the interface carrier, direction, capacity, safety margin and failure mode before detailed design or sourcing.
